children: Company Advances Toward Larger Contracts Pending ITAR Certification
Sector 4 import authorization—approved and effective September 17, 2026—positions HGI and Premier Graphene to pursue larger defense contracts pending ITAR certification
MEXICO CITY, Sept. 21, 2026
-- Premier Graphene Inc.

today announced that its affiliate, HGI Industrial Technologies, S.A.P.I. de C.V., has received official authorization from Mexico’s Servicio de Administración Tributaria (SAT), the country’s Tax Administration Service, to expand its registration in the Padrón de Importadores de Sectores Específicos (Registry of Importers of Specific Sectors) to include Sector 4: firearms, spare parts, accessories, and ammunition.

Issued and effective September 17, 2026, the authorization covers Sector 4, “Armas de fuego, refacciones, accesorios y munición” (firearms, spare parts, accessories, and ammunition). The SAT confirmed that HGI’s application for Actualización – Aumento y Disminución de Sectores Específicos (Update – Increase and Decrease of Specific Sectors) fully complies with applicable regulations under the Reglamento Interior del Servicio de Administración Tributaria (Internal Regulations of the Tax Administration Service) and the Reglas Generales de Comercio Exterior (General Rules of Foreign Trade), and the authority rendered the request “PROCEDENTE” (APPROVED / PROCEEDING).

With this authorization, HGI Industrial Technologies is now cleared to import products under the applicable tariff classifications, including munitions classified under fraction 9306.30.99. This classification covers bombs, grenades, torpedoes, mines, missiles, cartridges, and other munitions, projectiles, and their parts (including shot, pellets, and wads for cartridges), as well as related ammunition such as mortar rounds and other specialized munitions and accessories, including aircraft and vessels for military use, in each case subject to the applicable non-tariff regulations and restrictions.

Premier Graphene Inc. Chief Executive Officer Ivan Mendez said the Company is currently awaiting two pending approvals: ITAR brokerage certification and ITAR certification for the sale of graphite and graphene materials. Once those certifications are in hand, Premier intends to advance to larger contracts involving these product categories.

Pedro Mendez of HGI Industrial Technologies commented: “Approvals of this kind take time, as they require a thorough vetting process, and we are pleased to have secured these important authorizations. We now await the pending certifications of our affiliate, Premier Graphene Inc., which will allow us to pursue more complex, higher-value contracts that advance the national security interests of both countries.”

As is standard, the SAT notification notes that the authority retains the right to suspend registration in the Padrón de Importadores (Importers Registry) or the Padrón de Importadores de Sectores Específicos (Registry of Importers of Specific Sectors) under the conditions set forth in the applicable rules. All related registration and update procedures with the SAT are provided free of charge.

About HGI Industrial Technologies, S.A.P.I. de C.V.
HGI Industrial Technologies, S.A.P.I. de C.V.
RFC:HIT230628QK6

is an established, government-qualified Mexican defense contractor specializing in industrial technologies and regulated import activities. In collaboration with Nova Graphene Corp of Nova Scotia, HGI is establishing manufacturing capacity for graphene ballistic vests — including 3D-printed vests engineered specifically for women — and other specialized graphene protective products. The company is also engaged in rare earth mineral procurement in South America and is expanding into markets across Latin and South America. HGI is in discussions regarding potential funding from a major United States rare earth mineral company.
About Premier Graphene Inc.
Premier Graphene Inc.

is an established defense contractor operating in the United States and internationally. The company advances advanced-materials and technology initiatives spanning regulated product categories that require specialized import and export authorizations, and its ITAR certification is currently pending. Premier likewise pursues rare earth mineral procurement and market expansion across Latin and South America, complementing HGI's initiatives in the region.
